entry.title: sharebox: a FUSE filesystem for git-annex
entry.content: Christophe-Marie Duquesne has just announced Sharebox , a FUSE filesystem relying on git-annex: What are your goals? Seamless synchronization "à la dropbox". Ability to use with big binary files such as mp3/movies. Entirely decentralized. Don't use unnecessary space Keep it simple: avoid special VCS commands and keep a filesystem interface as much as possible. While still alpha, this is promising. -- Joey
